description.zh: 其他补充：用户可以在文本输入框中，通过自然语言的描述进行开放性调整，例如增加紧张刺激时刻的描述等等，帮助用户进行效果调整
description.en: Additional notes. Users can make open-ended adjustments by describing them in natural language within the text input box, such as adding descriptions of tense and exciting moments, to adjust the effect.

description.zh: 是否需要具体分镜对白，default=false
description.en: Whether specific shot dialogues are needed. Default is false.

description.zh: 可读性：用户可以勾选是否增加剧情冲突、反转情节的策划内容，勾选后可自动生成在剧情中
description.en: Users can check whether to add plot conflicts and inversion elements to the planning content. If checked, these are automatically generated in the plot.

description.zh: 自然语言输入剧本名称
description.en: Natural language input for the script name.

description.zh: 剧本的分镜数量：单个剧本内用户可以定义生成对应的镜头描述数量，取值范围为1~10个
description.en: Number of script shots. Users can define the number of shot descriptions to generate within a single script, with a value range of 1 to 10.

description.zh: 剧本梗概：用户针对该剧本进行简短的故事说明
description.en: Script synopsis. Users provide a brief story description for the script.

description.zh: 剧本类型关键词：用户针对该剧本类型进行定性描述，如历史架空、科幻、爱情、玄幻等描述
description.en: Script type keywords. Users provide qualitative descriptions for the script type, such as alternate history, sci-fi, romance, or fantasy.

description.zh: 阿里云百炼业务空间唯一标识：获取[业务空间ID（Workspace ID）](~~2782167~~)
description.en: Unique identifier for Alibaba Cloud Model Studio workspace. Get the [workspace ID](~~2782167~~).

title.zh: 影视互娱剧本创作-剧本策划
title.en: Film and Entertainment Playbook Creation – Playbook Planning

descriptions.zh: 根据用户对剧本前要的简单输入，就可得到剧本梗概及分镜头的简要描述，帮助编辑人员快速构思剧本框架
descriptions.en: You can input basic script requirements to generate a script synopsis and brief shot descriptions. This feature helps editors quickly create a script outline.
